data.name: Sipho
data.gender_notes: Sipho is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Zulu language, Sipho means 'gift' or 'gift from God'. This name is of great significance in Zulu culture and is often given to babies as a blessing from their ancestors and the divine. The name Sipho carries the meaning “Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Zulu. Parents who choose Sipho usually hope their child will grow to embody gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the divine gift of life and the blessings bestowed upon us.
data.etymology: Sipho belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sipho total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: סיפו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: סיפו הוא שם שמקורו בשפה האפריקאית, אך הוא משמש גם כחלק מהמסורת הנוצרית. הוא נגזר מהמילה 'סיפא', שפירושה 'מתנה' או 'מתנת אלוהים'. השם משקף את הרעיון של מתנה אלוהית למשפחה יהודית או נוצרית.

in_greek.name: Σίφο
in_greek.long_meaning: Σίφο είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την Αφρικανική γλώσσα, αλλά χρησιμοποιείται και στην Χριστιανική παράδοση. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με τη λέξη 'σίφο', που σημαίνει 'δώρο' ή 'δωροδοκία από τον Θεό'. Το όνομα αντανακλά την ιδέα του δώρου του Θεού για την οικογένεια.

in_latin.name: Sipho
in_latin.long_meaning: Sipho est nomen quod in traditione Christiana adhibetur. Etymologia nominis connectitur cum verbo 'donum', quod significat 'donum' vel 'munus a Deo datum'. Nomen reflectit ideam doni divini pro familia Christiana.

in_english.name: Sipho
in_english.meaning: Gift of God, divine present for the family
in_english.long_meaning: Sipho is a name used in Christian tradition, originating from African language. It is derived from the word 'sipho', meaning 'gift' or 'gift from God'. The name reflects the idea of a divine present for the family, symbolizing gratitude and blessing. Historically, it signifies the importance of divine providence in Christian culture.

data.cultural_impact: In Zulu culture, the name Sipho holds a deep significance as it signifies the value placed on God-given gifts and the collective belief that everything happens for a purpose.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Sipho reflects the belief that each individual is a gift from God, endowed with unique blessings and talents to use for the good of others and the greater glory of God.
